Open the [bulk Read later prototype](http://maker:4001/search.html?mode=live&readLater=check&bulk=mode&bulkActions=all).

1. Enter **Select items** mode.
2. Select the potato and color-palettes bookmarks.
3. Choose **Mark read later**.
4. Select the **Read later** filter.

Those two bookmarks should appear with the already-marked Kyoto bookmark, giving **3 results**, while the original two remain selected for another action.

I’ve assumed this batch action only turns Read later on; any already-marked selection remains marked. Please confirm whether that behavior is right.
